In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Se  the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 read with Sectio  the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed in  with Suti Police Station Case No. 282 of 2024 dated 2  under Sections 498(A)/302/34 of the IPC, 1860, charge  under Sections 498A/306/34 of the IPC, 1860 and under  4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
 And  In the matter of: Jamila Bewa and others  .
 Ms. Benajir Hasna,
 Mr. Aliul Islam  ....for  Mr. Debasish Roy,
 Mr. Arijit Ganguly,
 Ms. Sima Biswas  ..
 1.
The petitioners are the in-laws of the deceased.
It is submitted that they are innocent and the victim committed suicide after ten years of marriage.

2. The learned counsel for the State in opposing the prayer has referred to the statement of the independent witnesses and submits that the husband of the deceased was enlarged on bail by the trial court.

3. Considering the materials available in the case diary, the nature and extent of complicity of the petitioners in the commission of the alleged offence and that the post mortem report shows that the cause of death is suicidal in nature and no external injury was found on the body of the deceased and also having regard to the fact that charge Signed By :
